people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Set up a standard toward Zion. Flee for safety! Don’t wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.”
translations.bsb: Raise a signal flag toward Zion. Seek refuge! Do not delay! For I am bringing disaster from the north, and terrible destruction.
translations.kjv: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.
translations.asv: Set up a standard toward Zion: flee for safety, stay not; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.
